items.title: Curtis Fuller — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: when Dr. King had done all these things for gays, and rights, and women’s rights, the people that marched with King...

ctx.x: You said there were three things that happened that were associated…well, going back to Detroit, to school now. One was the school bus, the ride. What occasioned the ride? Give us some context for that.

We went to see the circus. We sat up in the corner. Actually it was in Grand Circus Park in Detroit, Michigan. It was right downtown, Lynwood Avenue. Every year, J.L Hudson used to have a parade. It was on T.V. around the country with the big floats, and the balloons and the singing kids. We were allowed to go there and stand in line with people and watch it. When we went to the Michigan Theatre we had to sit in the back row, you know? We weren’t even allowed in Dearborn even though that’s where the Ford Factory…
